title: [observability] A rejected gate verdict names the first check its deciding run failed and the count (masked, capped) in the task.gated record (failed {scenario, first, count}) and in the reason the page shows (GitHub #28)
prompt:
Spawn, objective 169 [observability] (GitHub #28; projects-47, 2026-11-14; rev-e; reviewer rev-g): a rejected gate verdict names the first check its deciding run failed, and how many it failed, in the task.gated record and where the rejection is shown.

R2 (rev-g's FIX F1 on R1, the scenario only; code unchanged, s169 56c27f0a): 169.sh adds a fourth task, (5). 093.sh fails on one blackbox line of 214 chars whose 200th char is a two-byte "é". failed.first must be exactly the first 200 chars and the reason "093.sh failed: <those> (regression: 093.sh fails on the candidate)". The mutants no-cut and byte-cut (cut at 200 bytes) are now killed by 169.sh at (5).

Where things stand. 129 (landed 11-13) names check-tests.sh's failing tests in the rejection's reason (verdicts.rs rejection_reason, from host::check_tests_failures). Every other rejection reads only the gate's reason, "scenario fails on the candidate" or "regression: <scenario> fails on the candidate", on the task row's "last gate", in the task panel, in the timeline and in the note. The failing check is the scenario's `blackbox: ` line in the gate's output, which the record keeps (`log`) and nobody reads. A live example (gate-logs 01a1d78e…, 149.sh): the verdict says "scenario fails on the candidate", while the log holds "| blackbox: (2) the checkout has no deploy/systemd/spawn-backup-restore-drill.service".

Read: crates/spawn-cli/src/integrate/verdicts.rs (rejection_reason, rejected_fields); integrate/host.rs (section, body, check_tests_failures); spawn-core/src/redact.rs (redact); integrate/landing.rs (cut); scripts/rsi/gate.sh (its "| == <phase>: <scenario> must …" and "| stage gate rejected <ms>ms <phase>: <scenario> must …" lines).

Required behaviour:
- host::rejected_checks(log) finds the deciding run. It takes the scenario that the gate's last "| stage gate rejected <ms>ms <phase>: <scenario> must …" line names; the closing "… total" line names none. That scenario's section starts at its last "| == <phase>: <scenario> must …" line before the stage line.
- The checks it reads: for check-tests.sh, its failing tests (129's check_tests_failures); for any other scenario, the section's "| blackbox: " lines, in order. Lines of other sections are not read. Empty blackbox lines are skipped.
- Each check is masked with spawn_core::redact::redact (the shape rules the event store applies on append: API key prefixes, Bearer, credential headers, URL passwords, *TOKEN/*SECRET/*PASS= assignments, JSON keys, credential flags), then cut to CHECK_CHARS = 200 chars at a char boundary (landing::cut).
- The rejected record (rejected_fields, the path every rejection's record takes) gains "failed": {"scenario", "first", "count"} when the run names a check, and has no field otherwise.
- The reason: check-tests.sh keeps 129's form unchanged. Any other scenario with a check reads "<scenario> failed: <first>", then "; and <n> more" when there are more, then the gate's reason in brackets: "149.sh failed: (2) the checkout has no … (scenario fails on the candidate)". The note quotes it ("The gate rejected this work: <reason>."). The page shows it with no web change: the task row's last gate, the task panel and the timeline show the whole reason.
- What stays as it is: gate.sh and its verdict file; the host-fault and base-disagrees decisions, which read the gate's own reason; every other field; a run with no check; the store (task.gated has no fixed shape); the web; Flake Doctor's need-verdict-changed (`changed`, not this objective).

Unit tests (integrate/host_fault_tests.rs):
- a scenario's first check: reason, note and `failed` exactly, with an earlier passing section's blackbox line not read;
- three checks: "; and 2 more", count 3;
- masking and the cap: a line with a ghp_ token behind Bearer and a PGPASSWORD= value gives [redacted] in failed.first and in the reason, neither value; a 500-char line of é is cut to 200 chars;
- no check: a run without a blackbox line, and an output whose stage line names no scenario, give the reason as before and no `failed`;
- check-tests.sh: failed {check-tests.sh, its first test, 7}, with 129's reason unchanged.

Files: candidate (169-fleet.diff, no protected path): crates/spawn-cli/src/integrate/host.rs (+49), integrate/verdicts.rs (+30 −6), integrate/host_fault_tests.rs (+142, tests). Code +79 −6; with tests +221 −6. Owner: rsi/scenarios/169.sh.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/169.sh, black box, with its own database and scratch HOME, as 129.sh. A recording gate (SPAWN_GATE) rejects three gated tasks; one `spawn integrate --once`; `spawn serve` answers.
(1) The task's own scenario 149.sh, failing on one blackbox line after an earlier passing section with a line of its own: last_gate.reason is exactly "149.sh failed: (2) the checkout has no made-up.service (scenario fails on the candidate)", and the review note begins "The gate rejected this work: <that reason>.".
(2) Its task.gated record has failed {"scenario":"149.sh","first":"(2) the checkout has no made-up.service","count":1}.
(3) 092.sh fails on two blackbox lines, the first with a GitHub token and a PGPASSWORD= value. The reason and failed.first hold [redacted] and neither value, the reason says "; and 1 more", and failed is {092.sh, count 2}.
(4) 046.sh with no blackbox line: the reason is exactly "regression: 046.sh fails on the candidate", and there is no failed.
(5) (R2) 093.sh fails on one blackbox line of 214 chars, its 200th char a two-byte "é": failed.first is exactly its first 200 chars (the "é" whole), and the reason is "093.sh failed: <those 200 chars> (regression: 093.sh fails on the candidate)".
The base (80debd0f) exits 1 at (1) to (3) and (5).

Proof: 169-proof.txt (rev-e-96).

Known, not this objective's: the record's `log` and the note's "Gate output (tail)" are stored unmasked, since control records are exempt from redact_event. That is objective 170 [recoverability].

Verified by: after the landing, the next live rejection by a scenario other than check-tests.sh. Its task row's last gate names the first failed check, and its task.gated record has failed {scenario, first, count}. GitHub #28 can then close when its 7 clean days are met.
